from pathlib import Path
import re
files=sorted(Path('main').glob('*.[ch]')) + sorted(Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/main').glob('*.c'))
rows=[]
for p in files:
    text=p.read_text(errors='replace')
    rows.append((text.count('\n')+1,len(text.encode()),str(p)))
for lines,size,path in sorted(rows, reverse=True):
    print(f'{lines:5d} lines {size:7d} bytes {path}')
print('=== LARGE FUNCTION HEURISTIC ===')
for p in files:
    text=p.read_text(errors='replace')
    lines=text.splitlines()
    i=0
    while i < len(lines):
        line=lines[i]
        if re.match(r'^(?:static\s+)?(?:[A-Za-z_][\w\s\*]*?)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(', line) and not line.lstrip().startswith(('if','for','while','switch')):
            start=i
            j=i
            sig=line
            while j < len(lines) and '{' not in sig and j-start < 12:
                j+=1
                if j < len(lines): sig += ' ' + lines[j]
            if j < len(lines) and '{' in sig and not sig.strip().endswith(';'):
                depth=0; begun=False; k=j
                while k < len(lines):
                    for ch in lines[k]:
                        if ch=='{': depth+=1; begun=True
                        elif ch=='}' and begun: depth-=1
                    if begun and depth==0: break
                    k+=1
                span=k-start+1
                if span >= 45:
                    m=re.search(r'([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(', sig)
                    name=m.group(1) if m else '?'
                    print(f'{span:4d} lines {p}:{start+1} {name}')
                i=max(i,k)
        i+=1
print('=== STATIC MUTABLE GLOBAL HEURISTIC ===')
for p in files:
    for n,line in enumerate(p.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines(),1):
        s=line.strip()
        if s.startswith('static ') and '(' not in s and not s.startswith('static const ') and ';' in s:
            print(f'{p}:{n}: {s[:180]}')
print('=== TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX ===')
for p in list(Path('.').rglob('*')):
    if p.is_file() and '.git' not in p.parts and p.stat().st_size < 1000000:
        try: txt=p.read_text()

        for n,line in enumerate(txt.splitlines(),1):
